name: eui-civ-ribbon
description: EUI's NotificationPanel.lua UpdateCivListNow (the civ ribbon) calls player:CalculateGoldRate() for every alive major in the ribbon that the active team has met and is not at war with. CalculateGoldRate looks like a getter but recomputes CvTreasury::m_iExpensePerTurnUnitMaintenance (serialized) in VP DLLs.
